# R4.5d — Anthropic Messages + OpenAI provider transports

Progress: 2026-10-21 — implement-spec run started; phase 0 orientation done.
Contract: `docs/tickets/154d_R4.5d__provider-transports-anthropic-openai.md`
(live verification, USD 5 leg allocation, 900-line budget with recorded
deviation if the contracted scope exceeds it).

## Plan (phase 1)

**Live posture.** `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` + `OPENAI_API_KEY` are provisioned
(names-only, `export`-ed by `live.env` → launch env of `cargo test`
children). Endpoints `https://api.anthropic.com` + `https://api.openai.com`
ride the R4.5c TLS stack — no new TLS work. Two `live-executed`
`GatewayModel` legs (`anthropic-call`, `openai-call`), smallest models,
tiny prompts, `max_tokens` floors.

**OpenAI surface choice.** Chat Completions (`/v1/chat/completions`):
the R4.5b-landed `ChatChunkTranslator`/SSE machinery is already
corpus-proven across the thirteen normalized shapes, and the contract asks
for a provider-faithful codec — Chat Completions is OpenAI's canonical
hosted surface. Responses API rejected: equivalent evidence would need a
new translator + corpus for no contracted delta.

**Design.**

- `hh-gateway::anthropic` — Messages adapter: request render
  (`messages[]`, top-level `system`, `tools[]{name,description,
  input_schema}`, `tool_choice{type:auto}`, mandatory `max_tokens`),
  SSE `event:`/`data:` translator (`message_start` → stream_start + usage,
  `content_block_start/delta/stop`, `input_json_delta` → ToolCallDelta,
  `thinking_delta` → ReasoningDelta, `signature_delta` → opaque
  ProviderNotice, `message_delta` → stop + usage, `ping` → ignored,
  `error` → ModelError), non-streaming `message` → frames, error_surface
  `error.type` normalization.
- `hh-gateway::dialects` — `anthropic-messages@1` + `openai@1` first-class
  `WireDialect` documents (shared chat-completions rule builder; full
  debt-recorded rules per family).
- `hh-gateway::credentials` — `BrokerCredentialPort`: resolves
  `credential_ref` (`env:NAME` → `SecretSource::LaunchEnv`) through
  `SecretSourceResolver` at bind; returns the secret-free
  `CredentialHandle{binding_id: "launch_env:NAME", provided}`.
  `NoCredentials` semantics preserved when no ref is bound.
- `HttpModelTransport` — dialect-keyed family dispatch (path
  `messages`/`chat/completions`, accept header, translator pick) +
  provider auth headers attached inside `send` from the handle's
  `binding_id` (launch-env resolution at the transport; the value never
  touches frames, handles, ledger rows, or logs). Anthropic:
  `x-api-key` + `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`; OpenAI: `Authorization:
  Bearer`. Unresolvable binding ⇒ typed `ModelError{auth}` refusal at send.
- `hh-embed::gateway_model` — `ModelLane.credential_ref` member (manifest
  round-trip); dialect-family transcript/body renderers (Anthropic tool
  carrier form: assistant `tool_use` blocks + user `tool_result` blocks);
  `credential_binding_id` on `model.call.requested` = the broker binding
  id (was the hardcoded `credentials:none`); `max_tokens` admitted as a
  `provider_params` member (`required_keys` on the Anthropic doc enforces
  presence).
- `hh-gateway-stub` — request member `transport: "live"` binds
  `HttpModelTransport` + `BrokerCredentialPort` in the OOP slot (the suite
  is unchanged — AC-R-2.3.1-11); absent ⇒ the C0 fake path byte-identical.
- Live legs — `live-verify.sh` `anthropic-call`/`openai-call`
  (kind `cargo-test`, `HH_LIVE_USAGE` marker → `token_usage` on the record
  + `cost_usd` from pinned `pricing.json`; console billing remains spend
  authority).

**Evidence layers.** corpus/fixture legs = `fixture-verified`; live legs =
`live-executed` via `hh-live-evidence/1` records; no staging/public claims.

## STOP — size budget (surfaced pre-landing)

Measured: **≈1,900 changed lines product+scripts** (src 1,783+/117−
incl. new `anthropic.rs` 543 + `credentials.rs` 189) + **≈2,652 test
lines** (corpus-bearing) = ≈4,550 code+tests vs the 900 budget
(generated/evidence rows excluded). The scope is atomic — two
provider-faithful dialect documents + live CredentialPort + transport
dispatch + OOP binding + live legs admit no honest seam — but the
deviation ruling belongs to the orchestrator (R4.4b–R4.5c precedents).
Work committed on-branch; **no push, no PR, no closeout** pending the
ruling.

## Deviation — orchestrator ruling 2026-10-21

≈4,550 product+test changed lines vs 900 (≈5×) — **accepted as recorded Deviation**: two provider dialect documents + the shared `CredentialPort` + dispatch + OOP variant are one atomic feature (a per-provider split is artificial; 2,652 of the lines are corpus-bearing request-render test batteries), already green under real verification incl. both executed live legs (bash.0006 total). Fifth consecutive live-track overrun (+245% / +45% / ≈+470% / +144% / ≈+405%) — systematic under-pricing carried to GATE-G7. Recorded limitation: `request_ids`/`response_headers` are empty on the hosted-call legs — ADR-0363 D2 permits empty; enriching them needs a `LIVE_HEADERS`-style marker in the test harness — deferred as a follow-on note for the operator rather than growing this deviated ticket. Operator's merge gate on the PR is the decision point.
